svg.title: Tsumugi-MRL architecture
svg.desc: Audio pretraining architecture with acoustic and symbolic teachers, a masked audio student, and three training losses.

div.div: Pretraining a music audio encoder from two frozen teachers
Mel-RVQ · trained in Stage 1 · frozen here
8 codebooks × 1024 · one row per 25 Hz frame
MIDI event Transformer · Stage 2 · frozen here
aligned MIDI — notes, beat, chord, key
4 codebooks × 512, plus one MIDI clip embedding
one query per frame, then RVQ
Audio student — Stage 3, the model being trained
sees a masked clip; must predict what the teachers saw in the unmasked one
symmetric InfoNCE, τ = 0.07 — each clip must match its own MIDI, not the others in the batch
musical code targets + MIDI clip embedding

audio [B, 2, S] · frame representations [B, T, 512] · acoustic codes [B, T, 8] · musical codes [B, T, 4] · embeddings [B, 256], T frames at 25 Hz. Padded frames are excluded from attention, pooling and every loss.
